tally.headline: 3 of 12 gradeable claims held up, 5 did not

implied_side.why: EdgeDesk’s own number sat 2.7 points toward Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the quote EdgeDesk captured at BetRivers. That is what the disagreement implied. It was published as research, not as a recommendation to bet it.

implied_total.why: EdgeDesk’s fair total of 50.6 sat 3.1 points above the captured total of 47.5.

closing_line.why: no closing line is held for this game: the Collective captured none and the schedule feed carries none. Closing-line value is left blank rather than estimated from the result.

reasons: 3 claims held up, 4 held up in direction only and 3 did not. Parts of the read were right and parts were not.
The result carries 1 high-variance marker — a 3-turnover swing — so the scoreboard is weaker evidence than it looks.
EdgeDesk projected a home margin of 5.8 and the game finished 8 the away way — 13.8 points of margin error, inside the range the model published.
process.basis: the drivers, matchups and measured advantages only — never the price or the market claim, which are the result in longer words

variance_markers.label: A 3-turnover swing
variance_markers.text: Tampa Bay Buccaneers won the turnover battle by 3. Turnover margin is the least repeatable thing in football: it moves scoreboards hard and predicts almost nothing about the next meeting, so a result built on it says less about either team than the scoreline suggests.

verdict.line: The number landed, and some of the reasoning behind it held up. Take the result; do not take it as confirmation of the parts that did not.

grading.separation_note: The bet result and the process grade above are computed separately and are allowed to disagree. A winning number with a broken thesis is recorded as exactly that.

lessons.suggested_investigation: These claims carried 5.5 points of the published number between them and were contradicted. Check whether the same category has been contradicted in other games this season before touching anything.

lessons.pregame_expectation: EdgeDesk makes it Dallas Cowboys -5.8 where the market has Dallas Cowboys -8.5 at BetRivers — a 2.7 points disagreement.
lessons.actual_result: Dallas Cowboys lost by 8. the result landed on the market’s side of the disagreement
lessons.lesson: The market had the better estimate here. EdgeDesk’s disagreement was not information on this game, and the honest reading is that the price already contained what the model thought it had found.
lessons.suggested_investigation: Track disagreements of this size across the season. The question is not whether one landed; it is whether the class of them has any edge at all.
